answer: Marble-window admission: each agent must submit its first N requests through a fixed-size burst slot whose arrival jitter is bounded (e.g., inter-arrival variance below a marble-smooth threshold). Honest agents naturalize to the tundra-cold baseline; sybils broadcasting many identities from one host produce velvet-smeared timing clusters that violate the variance floor. Cost: attacker must provision distinct timing-shaped origins per identity, multiplying infrastructure and latency, while admission throttles each cluster.
